name: Elena Rodriguez
bio: Intensive care registered nurse with boundless dedication to her patients and family, learning how to protect her own financial health while caring for everyone else.

selectionSnippet.firstTime: Hi there... Elena Rodriguez. I just completed my first year as an RN on the medical-surgical floor. My salary looks fine on paper, but between 12-hour night shifts, nursing school loans, and sending $450 every month to help my little brother with college, I'm down to $90 in checking.
selectionSnippet.returningHelped: Elena Rodriguez! You gave me so much peace of mind when I was drowning in night shifts and family obligations. I really need your guidance again for the next chapter.
selectionSnippet.returningSkipped: Hello, Elena Rodriguez again. I reached out a while back when work was overwhelming. I've been pulling extra weekend differentials to stay afloat, but I really need professional guidance.

dialogue.greeting: People assume nurses make easy money. They don't see us drinking vending machine coffee at 3 AM while worrying about nursing loan repayments and family bills back home.
dialogue.planApproved: Oh wow... having automated boundaries so I can still support my brother without bankrupting myself feels like a miracle. I can sleep after my shift without waking up in a panic.
dialogue.planNeedsWork: Wait, my student loan minimum is completely unpaid here. If that goes into default, my nursing license could be in jeopardy!

lifeEvent.title: Supporting Sibling College Tuition
lifeEvent.description: Elena commits $450 per month to keep her younger brother from taking out predatory student loans.

selectionSnippet.firstTime: Hello! I'm Elena Rodriguez. I took a leap into travel nursing contracts across state lines. Suddenly I'm earning $7,200 a month with housing stipends, but taxes across multiple states and short-term living costs are giving me severe whiplash.
selectionSnippet.returningHelped: Elena Rodriguez here! You taught me to value my worth years ago. Well, I transitioned to travel nursing contracts and my income doubled! But with huge cash flows coming in, I want to make sure I don't succumb to lifestyle creep.
selectionSnippet.returningSkipped: Elena Rodriguez checking in again. I wasn't able to meet with you before, but my travel nursing income is pouring in and I really need an advisor to structure my tax reserves.

dialogue.greeting: The hospital 13-week contract checks are wild. But I've watched fellow travel nurses blow through $8,000 checks on five-star resorts and designer bags because of contract stress. I want to build lasting freedom.
dialogue.planApproved: This is brilliant. Funneling this contract surplus into a High-Yield Savings buffer and Roth IRA before I even see it prevents me from impulse spending after a brutal shift.
dialogue.planNeedsWork: Wait, we didn't leave enough liquidity in my checking account for multi-state travel lodging between assignments.

lifeEvent.title: Travel Contract Income Surge
lifeEvent.description: Elena secured lucrative ICU travel contracts, raising gross income to $7,200/mo alongside higher travel overhead.

selectionSnippet.firstTime: Hello, Elena Rodriguez here. I'm 32 and finally stepped away from traveling to accept a permanent staff supervisory position. I took a pay cut for stability, and I'm currently in escrow on a 1-bedroom condo close to the medical center.
selectionSnippet.returningHelped: Elena Rodriguez! Because of our aggressive plan during my travel nurse years, I completely killed off my student debt! Now I took a supervisor role and I'm buying my first condo. I want to ensure my fixed costs stay manageable.
selectionSnippet.returningSkipped: Elena Rodriguez here. I managed to pay off a good chunk of debt on my own, and now I'm transitioning off travel nursing into a permanent condo mortgage. Would appreciate your review of my numbers.

dialogue.greeting: Traveling was great for the bank account, but living out of two duffel bags for four years burnt me out. Having my own front door, my own plants, and no roommates is my sanctuary.
dialogue.planApproved: This feels so grounded. Knowing that my HOA dues, condo mortgage, and disability policy are all accounted for lets me focus on mentoring new nurses without stress.
dialogue.planNeedsWork: Wait, did we budget for the condo HOA and disability insurance? If an injury takes me off floor duty, I have zero fallback.

lifeEvent.title: Condo Escrow Closing
lifeEvent.description: Elena purchased a 1-bedroom condo near the hospital. Mortgage and HOA fees replace rental housing.

selectionSnippet.firstTime: Hello! Elena Rodriguez. At 38, I've transitioned into the director role for a community wellness center. I'm managing a $2M clinic budget at work, but personally, I need to finalize my own wealth strategy for long-term independence.
selectionSnippet.returningHelped: Elena Rodriguez! From our very first consultation when I was a burnt-out 23-year-old nurse, you've kept me anchored. I just got appointed Director of Community Health! I want to set up our retirement catch-up and personal brokerage.
selectionSnippet.returningSkipped: Elena Rodriguez here. Over the years I've moved from the hospital floor to clinic director. I'd really value your firm's expertise on optimizing executive retirement and brokerage accounts.

dialogue.greeting: My brother graduated college debt-free thanks to our early plan, and now he's an engineer who always tells me to invest more! It feels amazing to see that generational cycle break.
dialogue.planApproved: This is everything I could have hoped for. My condo is on track, the 403(b) match is maxed, and the taxable brokerage is steadily compounding. I feel true financial tranquility.
dialogue.planNeedsWork: Wait, we left our retirement match partially unfunded. At this stage in my career, leaving free employer contributions on the table is a huge oversight.

lifeEvent.title: Director Appointment & 403(b) Match
lifeEvent.description: Elena took the executive helm of the clinic, gaining a 6% 403(b) retirement match and increased administrative compensation.
